global_premortem.failure_mode: chapter fallback or maxim-by-maxim fragmentation replaces discourse units
global_premortem.recovery: Restore the four parents and preserve question/answer, warning/remedy, analogy and example wholes.

global_premortem.failure_mode: dialogue punctuation, source identification or textual ambiguity is mistaken for a settled boundary
global_premortem.recovery: Null the selection, retain all exact routes and mark LOW/deferred.

global_premortem.failure_mode: chunking authorizes identity, faith/works, economic, office, healing, discipline, canon, doctrine or theology decisions
global_premortem.recovery: Reject the inference and retain candidate-only non-authorizing state.

global_guards: Greek syntax, source forms and dialogue punctuation are evidence only, not authority.
No witness, source, speaker, identity, authorship, history, faith/works, economic, office, healing, discipline, canon, doctrine or theology selection.
All contested routes LOW/deferred/candidate-only/non-authorizing; no forced consensus.
